rows.behavior: the worker CLI installs and runs as acs-agent; the installer replaces only its own link and never touches ~/.local/bin/agent

claims.claim: acs install-model-id puts acs-agent on PATH at ~/.local/bin/acs-agent, linked to ~/.agent-config-studio/bin/acs-agent
an existing acs-agent entry is replaced only when it is a symlink to that launcher; files and links elsewhere are refused
acs agent … runs the same CLI
